## Gumroad -> Airtable (live)
Every Gumroad sale/refund ping -> one row in Airtable **Sales**, keyed by **Sale ID**.

1. Credentials: *Airtable PAT* (scopes data.records:read/write, schema.bases:read) and *SMTP (alerts)*.
2. Airtable node: pick your base, table `Sales`.
3. Email alert: set your address.
4. Publish/activate, copy the **Production URL** of the webhook into Gumroad Ping.

Errors (Airtable down, bad payload) -> email via the Error Trigger below. This workflow is its own error workflow.

nodes.name: Gumroad Ping (sale webhook)
nodes.notes: Responds 200 instantly (Gumroad gives 5 s). Paste the Production URL into Gumroad > Settings > Advanced > Ping.

nodes.name: Normalize & validate
nodes.notes: Form fields -> clean typed columns. Validates sale_id, email, date, price, product_id.

nodes.name: Airtable: upsert by Sale ID
nodes.notes: Create or Update, merge on 'Sale ID' = idempotent. Same sale twice -> same row.
